name: inkhold-app
description: Web app shell (auth + file browser) for Inkhold. Static SPA, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && zig build wasm-note-decode && cp zig-out/bin/note-decode.wasm webapp/public/note-decode.wasm && zig build wasm-sqlite-core && cp zig-out/bin/sqlite-core.wasm webapp/public/sqlite-core.wasm && zig build wasm-pdf-decode && cp zig-out/bin/pdf-decode.wasm webapp/public/pdf-decode.wasm
scripts.test: npm run lint:styles && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
